meaning: Independent source-derived observations of a plain Enum definition and its owned-case component. Declared raw wire strings are not owned case objects.
input: Registered complete graph and reconciled plan; domainspec.typed-sum/v1 Enum nodes whose every variant has null payload. Every payload-bearing Enum remains explicitly not_evaluable; no variant or source node is dropped.
expectation: Use checked source names and qualified selector, not renderer output, to derive exact wire entries, case variants, equality truth table, key framing and invalid-input outcomes. Bind component contract and definition source hashes independently through the checked artifact plan. Definition objects and case objects must be frozen. Provider composition confirms definition ownership; component ownership rejects structural clones and foreign module-instance cases even when wire values coincide.
execution: Extend the existing permission-restricted pure semantic runner to declared plain Enum definitions/components and their exact forward native import closure. Preserve all Calculation controls, fixed environment, timeout/output limits, final inventory checks and no filesystem-write, network or subprocess grants. No application Operations, Workflows, servers, integrations, arbitrary user expressions or target writes.
coverage: Retain one row per source node including early failures. Pass selected-generator controls only after all nodes have passing controls; unimplemented sums and other adapters remain unmet. Apply existing per-node/project case and payload budgets to Enum cases too. Finite observations are not universal proof, cross-generator evidence or complete runtime conformance.
compatibility: No change to generated Enum forms, field semantics, nominal owned cases, canonical relationships, source layout, profiles, existing 43 source pins or defaults. This additive verification adapter extends the prior pure-Calculation execution ceiling only for plain Enum controls.
validation: Declared members and exact values, owned definition and component metadata
Distinct qualified same-name Enums, equality and key distinctions
Forged, raw, invalid and foreign-module cases rejected without getter/coercion execution
Native execution, compiling membership/ownership/equality/key/freeze mutants and final workspace drift
Payload-bearing sums retained unmet; source/snapshot/CLI and complete coverage regressions
